capabilities: Open daily notes that auto-create parent monthly and yearly notes
Open weekly, monthly, and yearly notes by entering the period number
Organize periodic notes in a year/month/day folder hierarchy
Set the folder where periodic notes are created
intentEvidence: Periodic notes in a year, month, and day folder hierarchy.
problem: Obsidian's periodic notes live in flat locations, so notes for different periods are not organized in a nested folder hierarchy.
summary: Plugin that creates daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly notes organized in a hierarchical year/month/day folder structure.
